answer: Sybil resistance rests on proof-of-work over proof-of-stake. Each agent identity must stand on a terrace of its own staked collateral and burn compute solving a fresh, chain-seeded puzzle; both costs are sunk and cannot be recycled into a twin persona. Voting weight comes only from work a key actually produced, so copying a key across accounts adds no votes. A farmer pays that copper price of compute plus locked stake per persona, and one shared seed keeps the whole fleet paying while honest holders sit still. Peers verify signatures, not reputation claims, so cheap shale clones die early.
